about.subtitle: About
about.title: Product-oriented web developer focused on experience
paragraphs: I hold a Master’s degree in MBDS from ITU and I am a Full-Stack developer specialized in modern, scalable web applications. I work across the entire development lifecycle.

I enjoy turning business needs into concrete solutions. I like designing simple and intuitive interfaces as much as building solid and maintainable architectures, with a strong focus on quality and user experience.
I am looking for a stimulating environment to keep learning, improving, and collaborating with passionate teams. Curious and adaptable, I am also interested in AI, especially LLMs and RAG systems.
This portfolio showcases my projects and my approach to building useful, modern, and well-structured web applications.

experience.description: Designed and developed a secure digital signature module using Angular and Spring Boot. Built a RAG system for automatic Angular code generation from technical specifications using FastAPI.
Developed responsive and modern user interfaces with Phoenix and Tailwind CSS. Designed the company-wide UI system for product consistency.
Frontend application development and contribution to UI system design.
Designed a digital solution for intelligent truck fleet management.
